description: Every image displayed in README.md or docs/ is classified here. 'paper' exhibits are committed under papers/ with their own producers and frozen inputs and are never regenerated by documentation tooling. 'synthetic' exhibits are teaching figures generated by a producer module in this directory from the article's canonical worked example.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: 120 synthetic month-end observations from 2016-01-31; 12 responses in 3 groups of 4; 4 correlated factors.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; loadings are dimensionless; nothing in the figure is annualised.
conventions.evaluation: LassoModelCV, 4 expanding-window folds, 9-point grid from 1e-6 to 1e-2; the selected model is refitted on the full sample.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: 120 synthetic month-end observations from 2015-01-31, the first 60 used for estimation; 6 responses; 8 candidate factors of which 3 carry a response.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.02 per month.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO on a 17-point grid from 1e-2 to 1e-6, CVXPY with CLARABEL, no sign constraints, zero prior.
conventions.evaluation: Loading RMSE against the generating loadings; ordinary least squares on the same 60 rows as the reference.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: 36 synthetic month-end observations from 2023-01-31; 6 responses; 3 factors with credit and equity 85% correlated; 50 redrawn panels for the right panel.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; idiosyncratic volatility 0.01 per month.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO with and without factors_beta_loading_signs and factors_beta_prior, CVXPY with CLARABEL.
conventions.evaluation: Loading RMSE against the generating loadings; the prior matrix is deliberately different from them.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: 48 synthetic month-end observations from 2022-01-31; 12 responses in 3 clusters of 4; 6 uncorrelated factors.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.025 per month.
conventions.estimator: LASSO, HIERARCHICAL_CLUSTER_GROUP_LASSO and FACTOR_CLUSTER_GROUP_LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-3, group_penalty='normalized', clusters discovered from the responses, no sign constraints.
conventions.evaluation: A loading counts as kept above 1e-3 in absolute value; false and missed are against the generating support.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: 240 synthetic month-end observations from 2006-01-31; 8 responses; 4 factors.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; factor volatility 0.04 and idiosyncratic volatility 0.02 per month; nothing is annualised.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO, CVXPY with CLARABEL, no sign constraints, zero prior.
conventions.evaluation: In-sample residuals. Held-out evaluation belongs to LassoModelDiagonalityCV.

conventions.data_kind: Synthetic teaching example; not market or paper-replication evidence.
conventions.sample: Synthetic month-end panels of 48, 72, 120 and 240 observations, 16 redrawn panels each; 40 responses; 4 factors with pairwise correlation 0.3.
conventions.returns: Decimal per-period returns; covariances are annualised by a factor of 12 and volatilities are shown in percent per year.
conventions.weighting: Uniform observation weights (span=None); demean=True; population (ddof=0) moments.
conventions.estimator: LassoModelType.LASSO at reg_lambda=1e-5; CurrentFactorCovarData.get_y_covar with the orthogonal residual type; the sample covariance as the reference.
conventions.evaluation: Against the population covariance of the generating process: relative Frobenius error, and the volatility under the population covariance of the fully invested minimum-variance portfolio.

assets.alt: Residual eigenvalues against the Marchenko-Pastur edge, and sphericity against its threshold along a penalty grid, with and without one factor.
True and estimated loadings of twelve funds on four factors, and mean held-out R-squared along the penalty grid with the selected penalty marked.
Loadings of one response on eight factors along the penalty grid, and the loading error of the panel against ordinary least squares.
Loading error along the penalty grid for a penalty centred on zero and on a prior, and the sampling distribution of the error for three estimators.
True loadings of twelve funds on six factors beside the loadings kept by the LASSO, HCGL and FCGL penalties at one common penalty.
Covariance error and realised minimum-variance volatility of the assembled factor covariance and the sample covariance for histories of 48 to 240 months.
